scope: Research and design analysis only; no code/service/site/Anvil/signing/journal changes or execution tests. Numeric examples are analytic illustrations, not tested performance or qualified market quotes.

geometry.notation: P is ETH per ZZZ; higher P means stronger ZZZ. Core currency0 ETH/currency1 ZZZ quotes the inverse, with raw sqrtPrice sqrt(ZZZ/ETH). Use actual tick-aligned boundaries and explicit orientation.
geometry.threshold: Lower=C-0.85*(C-L); upper=C+0.85*(U-C), using actual main price bounds. It is not85%absolute price movement.
geometry.one_sided_principal: For P below range lower, principal is ZZZ; above range upper, principal is ETH; strictly inside it is mixed. Actual equality/fee membership follows core tick semantics.
geometry.residual_direction: After main is actually funded, place residual ETH in a range below current P to buy ZZZ on decline; residual ZZZ in a range above P to sell ZZZ on rise. Place no other asset principal into that leg.
geometry.old_center_caveat: An old-centre endpoint is valid only when it lies on the required side for the ACTUAL residual asset. Residual type can reverse over cycles; choose a reviewed bounded width/fallback rather than use an invalid interval or wrong asset.
geometry.main_ratio_caveat: Arithmetic symmetric +/-price ranges are not log/tick symmetric, therefore centred main is not50/50 value. Actual Uniswap math determines ratio. Do not import Charm tick-symmetric50/50 examples literally.

state_cases.state: No main/no incumbent shares
state_cases.mechanics: First activation still creates the initial shared main from entrant funds. There is no passive adjustment or secondary history to consolidate.
state_cases.action_proposal: Use the existing exact contribution route/marginal-LP guards. Never treat initial mint as a triggered rebalance.

state_cases.state: Main active, no secondary, price inside85%threshold
state_cases.mechanics: Main continues trading and collecting fees. A changed balance ratio alone is not a new trigger.
state_cases.action_proposal: No adjustment; independent hourly harvest continues.

state_cases.state: Main active, both authenticated prices cross85%threshold on same side
state_cases.mechanics: Main can remain in range. A local pool-only distortion should not start an executable candidate.
state_cases.action_proposal: Start one identity-bound10minute sampled candidate. Preserve spot/reference and all financial/custody controls.

state_cases.state: Candidate returns inside threshold, crosses to opposite side, or identity/policy/read fails
state_cases.mechanics: Earlier evidence no longer proves the current condition. Hidden movements between samples are not detectable.
state_cases.action_proposal: Reset persistence and jitter; new same-side episode begins anew. Preserve pending-receipt recovery, no resends.

state_cases.state: Ten minutes sampled persistence complete, cooldown requirement unresolved
state_cases.mechanics: 600seconds is a minimum, not guaranteed inclusion. Current240second sampling reaches a fresh qualifying endpoint at about720seconds in an ideal schedule.
state_cases.action_proposal: Do not silently change four-minute cadence or12hourminimum. Decide whether cooldown remains and whether samples accumulate during it.

state_cases.state: Ready candidate plus random delay
state_cases.mechanics: A fresh60–300second service draw reduces static timing, not visibility of submitted calldata or market manipulation. Random values can repeat.
state_cases.action_proposal: Draw once per candidate with OS CSPRNG, persist across checks/restarts and revalidate while waiting. Optionally exclude the immediately preceding value; never promise globally unique delays.

state_cases.state: Atomic rebuild with both assets available
state_cases.mechanics: Harvest both existing legs, release only designated compound, close both; deploy the largest current main at approved range ratio; put only actual residual asset into one secondary.
state_cases.action_proposal: No balancing swap for this adjustment. Maintain aggregate USD retention at captured prices and exact token ownership/reserve separation. At most2physical legs.

state_cases.state: Both legs entirely ETH
state_cases.mechanics: Price is above the upper bounds of both positions in ZZZ-price-in-ETH view. Without fees/idle/other inventory providing ZZZ, a mixed centred main cannot be funded without a swap.
state_cases.action_proposal: Recognize inventory-limited state. Keep existing backing/positions and wait, rather than falsely claiming active recentering or silently forcing a swap. Governed exceptional alternatives require an explicit decision.

state_cases.state: Both legs entirely ZZZ
state_cases.mechanics: Price is below both lower bounds; no ETH minority exists except separate attributed assets. Recentring mixed main is similarly inventory-limited.
state_cases.action_proposal: Same inventory-limited handling; ETH gas funding is not principal and cannot subsidize the LP.

state_cases.state: One leg entirely ETH, other entirely ZZZ
state_cases.mechanics: Requires a disjoint-range gap where the lower range is above its upper edge and upper range is below its lower edge. For a centred main plus secondary abutting current price and overlapping main, this is unreachable at fixed ranges away from rounding gaps.
state_cases.action_proposal: If future geometry permits it, sum actual ETH/ZZZ and redeploy mixed main without a swap. Do not infer the asset from historical trigger direction.

state_cases.state: Main mixed, secondary one-sided
state_cases.mechanics: Expected immediately after rebuild. Secondary receives no active trading while price stays outside its bounds.
state_cases.action_proposal: Harvest main independently. Monitor main trigger; secondary existence/fill status must not spawn a third leg.

state_cases.state: Both legs mixed after reversal
state_cases.mechanics: Both ranges are now active; each naturally contains ETH and ZZZ. The original one-sided designation describes initial funding, not a permanent state.
state_cases.action_proposal: Leave both live until next approved adjustment. Harvest both into the same bucket. Never swap one leg back merely to restore its one-sided label.

state_cases.state: Main one-sided, secondary mixed
state_cases.mechanics: Possible when residual range extends beyond main bounds, for example old-centre anchor plus a narrower new main. Secondary may still earn fees while main is inactive.
state_cases.action_proposal: Report each leg separately; trigger eligibility is tied to approved main geometry, not a guessed combined range. Do not state total bucket earns zero solely because main is out.

state_cases.state: Secondary fully crossed, then price reverses and recrosses
state_cases.mechanics: Its conversion can unwind again while liquidity remains. This is a reversible range order, not a final filled order.
state_cases.action_proposal: Default minimal design leaves it until next adjustment; automatic completion removal is a separate proposed policy with gas/callback/accounting requirements. Explain the reversible behavior.

state_cases.state: Residual asset conflicts with prior trigger direction
state_cases.mechanics: Old secondary trades and fee/compound inventory can make either asset remain after the new main is funded. Prior up/down trigger is not sufficient.
state_cases.action_proposal: Determine direction from actual post-main raw residual under approved tick geometry. ETH residual belongs below current ZZZ price; ZZZ residual belongs above.

state_cases.state: Secondary cannot be minted due to invalid ticks/minimum/zero liquidity/token fault
state_cases.mechanics: A successful main plus stranded large residual may violate deployed/idle and retention policies.
state_cases.action_proposal: Atomic full adjustment rollback unless residual is explicitly below an approved bounded dust threshold and all existing retained-value/idle guards pass. No blanket ignore failure.

state_cases.state: Contribution/claim/transfer/harvest while candidate waits
state_cases.mechanics: Claims/transfers/harvest should not change principal range or reset timer. A contribution can reprice both incumbents through its own swap and changes NAV/supply.
state_cases.action_proposal: Allow ordinary atomic actions under their own guards; harvest both legs before new membership/shares; spend only entrant budget. Requote candidate sizing at execution. Genuine trigger/identity/policy failure resets; mere same-ID top-up must not automatically recenter.

state_cases.state: Repeated oscillation near threshold
state_cases.mechanics: Starting/cancelling candidates costs reads/observations; executed rebuilds incur gas and alter future inventory exposure even without swapping.
state_cases.action_proposal: Use reset/same-side persistence, one durable jitter and an explicit unresolved cooldown policy. Do not add a narrower reset hysteresis silently.

state_cases.state: Persistent directional trend
state_cases.mechanics: A one-sided mean-reversion residual may stay inactive indefinitely; future main rebuilds can be increasingly minority-limited. No-swap does not create the missing token.
state_cases.action_proposal: Expose active fraction/inventory-limited condition and let operator deliberately review policy. Do not guarantee recovery,50/50 or fee continuity.

state_cases.state: Terminal exit, parking, move, canonical handoff, emergency
state_cases.mechanics: All actual legs and attributed idle/compound remain one bucket principal entitlement. A forgotten secondary is lost backing.
state_cases.action_proposal: Close/harvest both for raw exit/park, validate zero surviving legs before canonical capture, bind both to custody/emergency identities, never mix holder or royalty/buyback liabilities.

financial_illustrations.conclusion: The85%threshold is already highly inventory-skewed. Passive recentring may reduce active capital to15–25%in these illustrations; it trades immediate swap avoidance for inventory/fee exposure.

risks.risk: Active liquidity collapse despite retained NAV
risks.assessment: At the upper85%trigger, recentring same-width main without swaps can place around15%of NAV into active main and85%into initially inactive residual. Current still-active original main was deploying all principal. This is a major deliberate fee/capital-efficiency tradeoff, not tiny dust handling.
risks.evidence: Analytic illustrative examples below; no tick rounding, fees or market quote.

risks.assessment: Avoiding an immediate keeper swap removes that swap fee and its direct price impact/sandwich surface. It does not reverse past divergence loss or guarantee better returns. Main+range-order inventory still sells into strength/buys into weakness and can underperform holding through trends/repeated recentering.

An attacker may distort placement price, influence the trigger or trade against newly placed liquidity. Independent corroboration, same-side persistence, final inclusion-time checks, exact bounds, captured accounting and nonarbitrary placement remain necessary. Charm marketing language about avoiding MEV is not a universal proof.

Current dualUSD-source ratio is not automatically a higher-liquidity-pool TWAP. A long local pump must not by itself qualify85%readiness. Preserve the existing independent-reference intent with threshold semantics instead of silently dropping it.

Closing2/minting2 plus fee harvest and context checks costs more than one-leg maintenance. If main allocation is small, added active-fee revenue may not justify recurring gas. Exact target-chain size/gas/economics remain unqualified.

Hard12hminimum, independent compound interval, confirmation samples and jitter are different. A10mincondition does not automatically replace12h. Missing/late observations restart under selected rules; unavailable data is not zero or ready.

minimal_lifecycle_proposals.proposal: One main plus zero/one secondary per bucket; consolidate both at next adjustment. Never accumulate old secondary legs.
Preserve manual +/-25/50% in ZZZ-price-in-ETH, current approved oracle/spot agreement and real outward tick rounding.
minimal_lifecycle_proposals.approval_status: Existing width requirement; new placement behavior not implemented

minimal_lifecycle_proposals.proposal: Use a configurable bounded width on the correct asset side; old centre can be a candidate anchor only if valid. No numeric default selected without operator review.
Explicit inventory_limited wait; do not consume holder fees/new entrants or force swap automatically.
Show independently valued active fraction and physical active liquidity before approval. Consider an operator-reviewed minimum to avoid silent85%inactive allocation; choose no arbitrary default now.
Omit secondary only for a reviewed economic dust threshold while preserving all exact retained-value and existing idle rules. Material failed mint reverts whole adjustment.
Leave until next adjustment for minimal lifecycle, document reversibility. Auto-remove-on-fill only if explicitly required as separate bounded action.
Preserve12h unless user explicitly replaces it; consider collecting condition evidence during cooldown to avoid blind waiting.
85%centre-to-edge;600seconds sampled persistence;fresh60–300secondsjitter; reset both on observed return/side/identity/policy/fault.
minimal_lifecycle_proposals.approval_status: User requested core semantics; precise cadence/confirmation mechanism not implemented

minimal_lifecycle_proposals.proposal: Keep80/10/5/5, principal shares, old owner unclaimed rights, hourly harvest, entrant isolation, raw collective return, strict profiles and Anvil-only signing unchanged.
